title: Cyrus the Great
summary: Founder of the Medo-Persian Empire; named by Isaiah as the deliverer of the exiles.

death.date: “Cyrus himself fell, after reigning nine and twenty years”
death.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.214 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 94 (PDF p. 96)
death.note: DERIVED (not Herodotus's figure): CFAH AP-7 (560/559 BC) − 29 = 531/530 BC for the death of Cyrus. CFAH-3 (AP-8) counts Cyrus 30 years (560 − 30 = 530 for Cambyses' accession), one year more than Herodotus. Generations prints Cyrus 600–530 BC (provisional), 0–1 year from the derived death.
